info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Training Information API
info.description: The Product Training Information API provides access to comprehensive training data for banking products. This API allows users to retrieve detailed descriptions, specifications, and training materials for various financial products offered by the institution. Typical consumers of this API include banking staff, product managers, and trainers who need to ensure they have the most up-to-date information to effectively educate clients and improve product knowledge. The endpoint supports seamless integration into internal training systems and facilitates efficient product training across the organization.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information regarding product training sessions, which can aid in understanding product features and usage.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to obtain the product training information. It must adhere to the defined schema, which includes all necessary parameters for the operation.

200.description: The request was successful, and the product training data is returned.

GetProductTrainingRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation in product training management. It is expected to be a string that provides details relevant to the request.

GetProductTrainingResponse_200.title: Product Training Response

items.description: An array of products returned in the response.

GetProductTrainingResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response for the product training operations. It includes an array of product items, pagination details, sorting information, and metadata.
